authority.note: Counts describe the accepted C1-T13 Chronicle corpus run only; they do not measure how much history actually existed or has been completely captured.

focus_window.note: The retained complete biographies naturally contain material outside this product focus window.

known_gaps: The six-source development acceptance used a source-bound model fixture; live-provider deployment quality, latency and reliability remain C1-T17 acceptance work.
The corpus is biographical/source-selective and must not be treated as balanced coverage across Wei, Shu, Wu, court, local society, economy, culture or geography.
Events without a verified normalized year remain visible as unknown-time coverage rather than being assigned an inferred year.
No additional canonical event relation was asserted by the C1-T13 pack; relation growth requires source evidence, not a coverage target.
A year with zero represented Events means only that the current Chronicle corpus has no published Event at that observed normalized year.
